summary: News Corp filed an 8-K reporting its ongoing stock repurchase program, originally authorized up to $1 billion of Class A and Class B common shares. The filing provides ASX disclosure of daily repurchase transactions as required by Australian rules. No specific price, stake, or premium is stated; the program is a capital return to shareholders, executed in open-market or negotiated purchases. No board resolution or advisor is named. The company continues to buy back shares subject to market conditions and securities laws. Watch for potential impact on stock liquidity and earnings per share as the buyback progresses.
